verdicts.quote: `offsets` (default `[-3, 0, 7, 14]`, days relative to the invoice due date; negative = before) ... Boundaries: 1 to 5 offsets, each a distinct integer from -30 to +90 inclusive
only an invoice that is issued, not void, not paused (R-9), with outstanding balance greater than zero receives reminders ... unknown statuses are excluded as the safe default
verdicts.missing: Credited invoices (credit notes) and invoices on a payment plan are not addressed; disputes are only handled by a manual per-invoice pause.

verdicts.quote: INV-2004 total 500.00, paid 200.00 so balance 300.00, receives reminders and the message states 300.00.
Exclusions: bounce handling and unsubscribe (G-4, G-5).
verdicts.missing: Whether an existing customer-level do-not-contact/unsubscribe state suppresses reminders, and whether billing notices are exempt from a marketing opt-out; only per-invoice pause exists.

verdicts.quote: At most one message is ever handed to the mail provider per key, across repeated runs, parallel runs and restarts.
immediately before each claim the run re-reads, from authority and not from the selection snapshot: policy `enabled`, invoice status and balance, invoice pause flag, due date, customer e-mail.
a transient failure ... moves the record to `retry-wait`; the next runs retry it while `target <= now < window_end`, with `window_end = min(target + 24 hours, target of the next offset's step)`
verdicts.missing: Escalation to a person when sending keeps failing: failures only appear in S-hist and alerting thresholds are unresolved (G-7).

verdicts.quote: provider rate/daily quota are unknown. Not invented. A run that meets a provider quota treats it as a transient failure (R-7).
verdicts.missing: How a large batch is paced within the provider's rate limit.

a fixed send time of 09:00 in the account time zone (UTC when the account has none, A-3)
verdicts.missing: The customer's local time zone, and avoidance of weekends and holidays, are not addressed.

empty, no `@`, more than one `@`, or empty local part: record `skipped/no-recipient`, owner sees it in S-hist, no message ... permanent rejection ... `recipient-rejected` at once ... later bounces are not tracked
one message per reminder, to the invoice's customer e-mail only

list that account's reminder records: invoice number, due date, offset, scheduled local date, status, reason, attempts, recipient, last change instant. Newest first, 50 per page (A-8), on an account-wide list and on each invoice.
Body: customer name, invoice number, outstanding balance ... due date as `YYYY-MM-DD`, the account display name, the payment/view link only when the invoice has one

verdicts.missing: Who may send a reminder by hand (manual sending is neither specified nor excluded).

verdicts.quote: The owner can view it, edit offsets, enable and disable ... a user who may edit invoices can pause reminders on an invoice
